text:
Jules (design): design check: proposing a keyboard-first "allocation rail" for rollout timeline. single-line chips show 'Stage 8%' and expand to an overlay for exact controls. thoughts?
Priyanka: love keyboard-first. question: overlay or inline expansion? overlays avoid layout shift but can be tricky with screenreaders.
Luca: overlay is fine if we manage focus. aria-modal, trap focus, and return focus on close. also add aria-expanded on the chip button.
Ned (eng): perf note: timeline hover currently fires metrics per node. let's cache sparklines and debounce full metrics by 300ms. avoids jank on quick scrubs.
Maya (product): microcopy - "Stage" is clearer than "Canary" for non-technical users. Tooltip: "Staged rollout (aka canary / A/B)". keep primary label short.
Jules (design): ok primary="Stage" secondary="Start small, grow gradually" tooltip="Canary / A-B". overlay header will show version + current allocation.
Priyanka: accessibility: announce allocation changes with aria-live region and ensure overlay's first focusable is the slider or exact input. if slider changes require confirm, focus should move to Apply button after interaction.
Luca: implement Apply button (no auto-save). also include a small undo toast after apply with keyboard-focusable Undo link.
Ned (eng): audit: require reason when delta >= 20%. we'll add a required textarea in the overlay for those cases and log user+note.
Maya (product): tone of modal copy: avoid alarmist language. propose: "Re-route live traffic to this version. This will change responses but will not remove historical data." Add small helper: "Add a short reason for the audit log (optional)."
Jules (design): agree. for >20% require reason, for >50% require a checkbox "I understand this may affect live users". two-step only for big deltas.
Priyanka: keyboard flow: chip button Tab -> Enter to open -> focus slider -> Tab to exact input -> Tab to Apply -> After Apply, toast gets focusable Undo. On close, return focus to chip. write unit tests for focus return.
Luca: CSS/accessibility nit: small allocation badges at 10% need higher contrast. suggest background #fff6e0 and text #10202a; add focus ring: ```css .alloc-chip:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(2,132,199,0.18); } ```
Ned (eng): debounce plan: cache sparkline payloads for session, show cached immediately, then lazy-load expanded metrics. implement 300ms debounce on hover/scrub events.
Maya (product): timeline actions: we need keyboard parity for rollback. show kebab menu on focus with "Re-route to this snapshot" and then modal flow. keep copy gentle: "Re-route traffic to this snapshot. This will not delete historical records."
Jules (design): rollout preview link for current branch: https://console.redwood.ai/preview/ux/allocation-rail :white_check_mark: (deploy-bot)
deploy-bot: preview available: https://console.redwood.ai/preview/ux/allocation-rail :white_check_mark:
Priyanka: accessibility checklist before merge: focus management tests, aria-live announcements for allocation change and undo, color contrast verification at 12px, ensure overlay announced with role=dialog and aria-label.
Luca: i'll add keyboard nav for scrubber (arrow keys moves selection, Enter opens overlay) and tests for arrow key behavior.
Ned (eng): i'll add debounce/cache + audit hooks and expose a feature flag for stricter reason thresholds for enterprise orgs.
Maya (product): i'll update copy strings in content repo and sync on the exact helper phrasing.
Jules (design): follow-ups: Priyanka run a11y sweep after deploy, Luca add keyboard scrubbing & overlay focus code, Ned wire audit + debounce, Maya push copy PR. aim to ship next sprint. :rocket:
